method: Phase 1 WCS pipeline at a 0.01-degree requested grid; 0-30 cm depth-weighted means (5/10/15 cm layers); uncertainty widths from Q0.05/Q0.95 at 5-15 cm. Cells inside the union of the 14 ADM1 polygons only, scan order, uint8-quantized.
resolutionNote: SoilGrids source models at 250 m; the WCS response resamples onto this ~1 km grid. Farm values are modelled predictions for the containing cell, NOT laboratory measurements and NOT 250 m-native samples. Regional Phase 1 estimates remain fallback.
